observation.subject: GET /api/admin/users/{login}
observation.sentence: `GET /api/admin/users/{login}`: warm median 7.2 ms over 71 requests, none of it in a recorded call; Spring WebFlux marks no phases, so where that time went is not known. Median CPU 7.0 ms and 954 KB allocated per request. First request 23 ms (cold).
whatToCheck: Open the slowest exemplar request in Live Activity to see its timeline.
limitations: Spring WebFlux marks no phases, so filters, handler, and response write are one unattributed span around the calls, out of which only authentication time is named.
This application's database access is not recorded: it uses R2DBC, and BootUI records JDBC statements through a traced DataSource, not R2DBC. Its SQL and connection evidence is not counted.
observation.unlistedReason: Its time is not split into phases, since its requests reached no handler BootUI marks or named nothing at all, and its warm median is under 20 ms.
